## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Filed as ②, but routed as a Studio UX improvement: no contract or product question is open

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T16:23Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in the Studio field-type picker ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the Studio browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`).

- **Why not the decision box:** a searchable, grouped picker with icons and descriptions changes no field type and no contract. Why p3: the flat list works.
- **Direction:**
  - a searchable picker grouped by kind, with an icon and a one-line description per type, on the repository's existing combobox primitive
  - descriptions come from the spec's field-type metadata where it exists
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

File surface (on `9cb4e29`), under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`:
- `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`: the *Type* control (`InspectorSelectField` with `typeOptions`, about `:974`) and `buildTypeOptions` (about `:486`);
- at most one new module-private picker module beside it (`inspectors/`), built on the repository's existing combobox (`packages/components/src/custom/combobox.tsx`, import only);

- new `designer.field.*` / `engine.fieldTypeDesc.*` rows of `i18n.ts` (en and zh), only for descriptions the spec does not already carry;
- the tests beside them;
- `.changeset/11793-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it: `packages/components/src/ui/**` (objectui AGENTS.md #7) and `packages/components/src/custom/combobox.tsx`'s own code; `packages/i18n/**`; what a type change does to the field (`changeType`'s behaviour stays as it is). Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui app-shell Studio: the field inspector's Type control is one flat Select of 46 entries ("Text · Text" … "Advanced · Vector") with no search, icons or descriptions | the platform path: the Studio catalog already groups the types by category with an icon per type (FIELD_TYPE_META, TYPES_BY_CATEGORY), and a combobox exists in @object-ui/components' custom layer | every author adding or retyping a field in Studio`
Thread-read: 6042134418
Serial constraints cleared: this seat's objectui#11782 (`b0aa892`) and objectui#11786 (`04c8f56`), which edited `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`, have landed. No in-flight claim in the lane names `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`, and no open objectui PR touches it (read 2026-10-08T04:47Z).

Why `Clause-②: no`: a Studio-internal control. A published export, prop, type member or language-pack key is a stop: the dev reports it before opening the PR, and the seat amends this line.
